narrative.overview:
The site is a street poster pasted on the league's wall with the official scoreboard mounted on top. Ground is light concrete, type and rules are ink, and the one loud color is the yellow of the pila, used as a flat slab at page scale. The only imagery is real: YouTube thumbnails of the battles and playlist cover photos, loaded remotely and never filtered.

Density is medium and operational: phone-first, tap targets of 44-48px, big tabular numbers, and rules that are visible on the page. Surfaces are flat and hard-edged. Depth comes from the concrete / ink / yellow contrast between blocks, never from shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Concrete ground, ink panels, one yellow slab per view.
Anton uppercase for headlines and big numerals; Archivo for everything read.
Square corners everywhere; the ink scoreboard panel alone carries a 4px radius.
2px ink rules separate content; thin ink-line (#34342f) rules separate rows inside ink panels.
Zero shadows, zero gradients, zero blur.
Status is carried by shape and text, color is secondary.

rules.name: The Slab Rule
rules.body: Yellow is a full block (hero slab, notice bar, chip), never a thin accent, glow, or gradient. One slab per viewport.

rules.name: The Ink Pair Rule
rules.body: Text on yellow is ink; text on ink is paper or yellow; ink buttons carry yellow text. Never yellow text on concrete.

rules.name: The Red Is Today Rule
rules.body: Red appears only for event-day status and errors.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every score, record, count, and countdown uses tabular numerals (.num).

rules.name: The Real Text Rule
rules.body: Labels are real information (column heads, statuses), never decorative overline text above headings.

rules.name: The Flat Wall Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. Separation is a rule or a change of material, never a shadow.

dos: Do use yellow as a block with ink text, one slab per view.
Do put the leader, champion, and totals in Anton tabular numerals.
Do use 2px ink rules between content on concrete and ink-line rules inside ink panels.
Do switch the focus ring to yellow on ink surfaces and keep it ink on light surfaces (3px, 2px offset).
Do keep tap targets at 44px or more (buttons 48px).
Do use only real photos (YouTube thumbnails, playlist covers) without filters; keep the crop anchored at 50% 20%.
Do state rules and uncertainty in plain text (scoring rules, tie rule, provisional notice).
donts: Don't use shadows, gradients, glows, or blur; the build has none.
Don't round corners beyond the 4px scoreboard panel.
Don't add dark "esports arena" gold-on-black styling or metric-card grids.
Don't use red for anything other than event-day status and errors.
Don't label en_vivo as a live stream; it means event day.
Don't put yellow text on concrete.
